newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring/white bids higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring/white bids higher.

text.p: Dark northern spring and white wheat bids were mostly higher on Tuesday in line with gains in the wheat futures markets, merchandisers said.

MGE spring wheat futures settled higher on spillover support from the closing rally in CBOT and KCBT wheat futures, traders said. Some traders speculated that the runup may have come on talk that logistical problems in Canada had caused some foreign buyers to opt for U.S. spring wheat.
Dealers also reported a pickup in farmer sales in Montana. "Farmers like the price," one said.
Also, one Minnesota broker noted a lot of cars on the floor and that rail cars were moving grain.
